summary: Name-squat of vue-demi with placeholder content
details: Package name 'vue-demi-fix' resembles the popular 'vue-demi' package. The tarball contains only a single console.log statement and a README self-labeled as a 'Proof-of-concept Claimed By Shad0w For Responsible Disclosure'. There are no install/lifecycle hooks, no network I/O, no credential access, and no executable payload — installing the current version does not harm the installer. The concern is solely the name-squat: a user mistyping 'vue-demi' could resolve to this package, and the namespace claim could later be repurposed to ship a harmful version. Name-similarity without payload is a subjective judgment that warrants human assessment rather than an automated block.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
